note: rows of the EDGAR submissions index, verbatim under EDGAR's own field names, kept as the source of the expected acceptance stamps in tests/test_fetch_fixtures.py. Read with the declared User-Agent (src/fetch_fixtures.py DEFAULT_USER_AGENT). The index is not stored whole because it lists filings after this store's as_of; the sha256 and byte count are of the whole index as EDGAR served it, the same bytes at both reads. `row` is the 10-Q the queue item names. `rows_beside_committed_headers` are NVDA's two 10-Ks, whose SGML submission headers (ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME, EDGAR's Eastern wall clock, no zone) are committed fixtures held to NVDA's manifest.json hash at tests/fixtures/NVDA/10-K/<accession>/<accession>-index-headers.html: each pair is the evidence for what the index's Z means. Kept here rather than under tests/fixtures/NVDA/, where every file is a document the store's manifest lists (tests/test_fixtures.py) and this record is not one.
